stories.title: Create FilterableCardGrid and CardGridItem elementary components
stories.description: Create two reusable React components (no Strapi schema). CardGridItem renders a single card using shadcn Card restyled to match strapi.io grid items — supports two visual modes: 'story' (top image + logo + title + CTA link) and 'integration' (logo + title + description, no top image). FilterableCardGrid provides a two-column layout (left sidebar with search + filter controls, right area with configurable-column grid) with client-side search/filter and 'See more' pagination.
stories.notes: Grid items differ between user-stories (image+logo+title+cta) and integrations (logo+title+description). Use variant prop or slot pattern so both can reuse the same card component. The grid itself is purely presentational — data comes from the parent section component. Completed: used @phosphor-icons/react/ssr (not lucide-react), ReadonlyArray replaced with readonly T[], extracted itemMatchesGroup helper to reduce nesting depth.
